I am currently undergoing treatment under a doctor from Kolkata for the past few years (due to distance from xyz to Kolkata I consult with every 6 months gap), if needed I consult with local Doctor from xyz. Since I am alone, I cannot make any special consideration for better treatment facilities at tertiary level Medical Institution. I have been suffering for a long time but I have not been able to do anything. I need further treatment now. I am following prescription and I am better, except for headaches and back pains.
